theme: An open day that's mostly yours — one call, and travel to get ready for.
greeting: The calendar's nearly empty today, Dan — a single afternoon call with Mike. That leaves the day bending toward reading, packing, and closing out a few overdue things.

needsAttention.title: Mike's oral-surgery prep
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Aug 14 in Personal Tasks. Surgery is Thursday in Portland, and today's step on your list is confirming pre-op instructions with the surgeon's office.

needsAttention.title: Buy the Croatia flights
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Aug 15 in your Inbox list — fares only climb the longer this sits, and the trip hinges on locking dates.

needsAttention.title: Lock a time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: She wrote back Aug 14 with slots for a PRI catch-up; the Monday window has passed, so Thursday is the one still open and waiting on your yes.

needsAttention.title: Talkiatry visit at 10 AM
needsAttention.detail: Your follow-up with Dr. Snowden is a virtual visit tomorrow morning — worth having your notes ready tonight.

flagged.title: New LinkedIn message from Peter
flagged.detail: A message is sitting in your LinkedIn inbox awaiting a reply — worth a glance given the search.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley holdings notice
flagged.detail: Proxy and holdings information from Morgan Stanley Private Markets & Alternatives arrived Friday.

flagged.title: Mike's Sustainalytics idea
flagged.detail: Mike floated reaching out to Sustainalytics' stewardship clients now that Morningstar is winding that business down.

flagged.title: Boat leads from Dan Mac
flagged.detail: He came back on your boat hunt — Luders 33, Cape Dory, a Nicholson 31, one near Penobscot.

inbox.noise: Amtrak survey, Fog Linen welcome, Nautilus and Midcoast Villager newsletters, and the LinkedIn job digests.
inbox.clear: Nothing urgent is buried in the rest.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Peak-summer zucchini and just-picked tomatoes, softened slowly in good olive oil — exactly the unhurried supper a quiet Maine evening is asking for.

acts.line: A quiet stretch to yourself — reading and travel prep before anything is on the clock.
Your 2 o'clock call with Mike is the only fixed point on the day.
The girls are with Jen, so the evening's yours — pack the small bags and crack the new book.
